run_upgrade_model_version: run the CLI tool to upgrade an MMDetection checkpoint from an older version to the latest
convert_checkpoint: convert an old MMDetection model checkpoint to the latest version with a specified number of classes
reorder_cls_channel: reorder classification channels in a PyTorch tensor to match the updated class ordering
truncate_cls_channel: truncate classification output channels by removing the background class from a model tensor
parse_config: parse an MMDetection config string to detect whether the model is two-stage, SSD, Retina, or agnostic
